budget_categories.name: Permits, Safety & City Fees
budget_categories.rationale: Municipal park/street permits, traffic management, event insurance, and first-aid medics.
budget_categories.saving_tip: Partner with local civic organizations or municipal departments for fee waivers.

budget_categories.name: Sound, Stage & Power
budget_categories.rationale: Stage platform, sound PA system, wireless microphones, technician, and portable generator.
budget_categories.saving_tip: Borrow municipal or local school portable PA gear if permitted.

budget_categories.name: Sanitation & Waste Management
budget_categories.rationale: Portable restrooms, handwashing stations, recycling bins, and post-event cleanup crew.
budget_categories.saving_tip: Organize a volunteer green squad to sort compost and recyclables during the event.

budget_categories.name: Refreshments & Water Hubs
budget_categories.rationale: Free water refill stations, healthy snacks, volunteer meal vouchers, and fruit.
budget_categories.saving_tip: Invite independent local food trucks who pay a vendor booth fee to attend.

budget_categories.name: Signage, Marketing & Volunteer Kit
budget_categories.rationale: Large wayfinding banners, accessible maps, volunteer high-vis vests, and promotional flyers.
budget_categories.saving_tip: Use reusable chalkboard and weather-resistant whiteboard A-frame directional signs.

budget_categories.name: Activity Supplies & Workshop Materials
budget_categories.rationale: Sports gear, arts and crafts supplies, workshop tool kits, or educational materials.
budget_categories.saving_tip: Run a neighborhood donation drive for reusable tools, balls, and art supplies.

milestones.title: Submit Municipal Permits & Insurance Application
milestones.notes: File park/street closure notice, noise variance, and public liability certificate.

milestones.title: Finalize Health & Safety and Waste Logistics Plan
milestones.notes: Book portable toilets, first aid station team, and waste disposal bins.

milestones.title: Recruit & Assign Community Volunteers
milestones.notes: Assign team leads for setup, greeting, accessibility assistance, and clean-up.

milestones.title: Confirm Sound, Stage & Electric Hookups
milestones.notes: Coordinate generator safety clearances and speaker positioning.

milestones.title: Host On-Site Volunteer Walkthrough
milestones.notes: Distribute emergency contacts, safety vests, and two-way radios.

run_of_show.notes: Open gates, position portable restrooms and sanitation stations.

run_of_show.activity: Sound and Stage Setup & Sound Check
run_of_show.notes: Check microphone levels and cable covers for wheelchair access.
Issue vests, badges, two-way radios, and station assignments.
Announce first aid location, restrooms, and schedule of activities.
Spotlight local grassroots organizations and talent.
Acknowledge volunteers, partners, and neighborhood sponsors.
Litter sweep, recycle sorting, return site in pristine condition.

vendor_categories.title: Municipal Authority & First Aid Agency
questions_to_ask: What are the mandatory public liability limits required for this outdoor assembly?
Are certified emergency first responders legally required on site for our expected attendance?
What is the submission deadline for sound amplification variances?
documents_to_verify: Public liability insurance certificate naming city as additional insured
red_flags: Operating without written permits from city department
Inadequate egress routes for emergency medical vehicles

vendor_categories.title: Audio Visual & Staging Provider
questions_to_ask: Do you provide rubber cable ramps to prevent tripping hazards across walkways?
Are your generators rated for low-noise emissions in public park spaces?
Is an on-site audio engineer present throughout the entire operating window?
documents_to_verify: Equipment rental manifest with rain cover protections
red_flags: Uncovered cables stretching across pedestrian or accessible paths
No waterproof covers for outdoor electrical gear

vendor_categories.title: Sanitation & Recycling Service
questions_to_ask: How many ADA-compliant wheelchair accessible portable toilets are included?
What is the schedule for pumping and servicing during multi-hour operations?
Do you provide dedicated sorting bins for compost, recycling, and landfill?
documents_to_verify: Sanitation service agreement with delivery and pickup timelines
Waste disposal and recycling compliance certification
red_flags: Delivery scheduled during public arrival rather than prior to gates opening
Failure to include handwashing or sanitizing stations
